request.query: A set is finite if its image is finite and every fiber is finite

content.text:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "formal_name": "Set.Finite.of_finite_fibers",
      "informal_name": "Finite Set Criterion: Finite Image and Finite Fibers",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (f : α → β) {s : Set α}, (f '' s).Finite → (∀ x ∈ f '' s, (s ∩ f ⁻¹' {x}).Finite) → s.Finite",
      "informal_description": "Let $ f : \\alpha \\to \\beta $ be a function and $ s \\subseteq \\alpha $. If the image $ f(s) $ is finite, and for every $ x \\in f(s) $, the intersection $ s \\cap f^{-1}(\\{x\\}) $ is finite, then $ s $ is finite.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Set.Finite.Lattice"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Finite.Set.finite_replacement",
      "informal_name": "Image of Finite Set Under Function is Finite",
      "kind": "instance",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [Finite α] (f : α → β), Finite ↑{x | ∃ x_1, f x_1 = x}",
      "informal_description": "If $ \\alpha $ is a finite type and $ f : \\alpha \\to \\beta $ is a function, then the image $ \\{ f(x) \\mid x : \\alpha \\} $ is a finite set in $ \\beta $. This instance asserts that the set of values obtained by applying $ f $ to all elements of $ \\alpha $ remains finite when $ \\alpha $ itself is finite.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Set.Finite.Range"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Set.Finite.preimage'",
      "informal_name": "Preimage of a Finite Set Under a Function with Finite Fibers is Finite",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {f : α → β} {s : Set β}, s.Finite → (∀ b ∈ s, (f ⁻¹' {b}).Finite) → (f ⁻¹' s).Finite",
      "informal_description": "If $ s $ is a finite set and for every element $ b \\in s $, the preimage $ f^{-1}(\\{b\\}) $ is finite, then the preimage $ f^{-1}(s) $ is finite.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Set.Finite.Lattice"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Set.Finite.dependent_image",
      "informal_name": "Dependent Image of Finite Set is Finite",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {s : Set α},\n  s.Finite → ∀ (F : (i : α) → i ∈ s → β), {y | ∃ x, ∃ (hx : x ∈ s), F x hx = y}.Finite",
      "informal_description": "If $ s $ is a finite set and $ F $ is a dependent function from $ s $ to $ \\beta $, then the image of $ F $, defined as $ \\{ y \\in \\beta \\mid \\exists x \\in s,\\ F(x) = y \\} $, is a finite set in $ \\beta $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Set.Finite.Range"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Set.finite_of_finite_preimage",
      "informal_name": "Finite Set from Finite Preimage and Subset of Image",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {f : α → β} {s : Set β}, (f ⁻¹' s).Finite → s ⊆ Set.range f → s.Finite",
      "informal_description": "If the preimage $ f^{-1}(s) $ of a set $ s $ under a function $ f $ is finite and $ s $ is a subset of the image of $ f $, then $ s $ is finite.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Set.Finite.Basic"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Finite.Set.finite_image",
      "informal_name": "Image of a Finite Set Under a Function is Finite",
      "kind": "instance",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (s : Set α) (f : α → β) [Finite ↑s], Finite ↑(f '' s)",
      "informal_description": "The image of a finite set under any function is finite.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Set.Finite.Basic"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Finite.Set.finite_range",
      "informal_name": "Finite Range of Function with Finite Domain",
      "kind": "instance",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u} {ι : Sort w} (f : ι → α) [Finite ι], Finite ↑(Set.range f)",
      "informal_description": "If $ \\iota $ is a finite type and $ f : \\iota \\to \\alpha $ is a function, then the range (image) of $ f $ is a finite subset of $ \\alpha $. This instance asserts that the image of a finite set under any function remains finite.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Set.Finite.Range"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Finite.Set.finite_seq",
      "informal_name": "Image of Finite Sets Under Function Application is Finite",
      "kind": "instance",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (f : Set (α → β)) (s : Set α) [Finite ↑f] [Finite ↑s], Finite ↑(f.seq s)",
      "informal_description": "If $ f $ is a finite set of functions from $ \\alpha $ to $ \\beta $ and $ s $ is a finite subset of $ \\alpha $, then the set $ \\{ f(a) \\mid f \\in f,\\, a \\in s \\} $ obtained by applying all functions in $ f $ to all elements in $ s $ is finite.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Set.Finite.Monad"
    }
  ]

items.informal_name: Finite Set Criterion: Finite Image and Finite Fibers
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (f : α → β) {s : Set α}, (f '' s).Finite → (∀ x ∈ f '' s, (s ∩ f ⁻¹' {x}).Finite) → s.Finite
items.informal_description: Let $ f : \alpha \to \beta $ be a function and $ s \subseteq \alpha $. If the image $ f(s) $ is finite, and for every $ x \in f(s) $, the intersection $ s \cap f^{-1}(\{x\}) $ is finite, then $ s $ is finite.

items.informal_name: Image of Finite Set Under Function is Finite
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [Finite α] (f : α → β), Finite ↑{x | ∃ x_1, f x_1 = x}
items.informal_description: If $ \alpha $ is a finite type and $ f : \alpha \to \beta $ is a function, then the image $ \{ f(x) \mid x : \alpha \} $ is a finite set in $ \beta $. This instance asserts that the set of values obtained by applying $ f $ to all elements of $ \alpha $ remains finite when $ \alpha $ itself is finite.

items.informal_name: Preimage of a Finite Set Under a Function with Finite Fibers is Finite
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {f : α → β} {s : Set β}, s.Finite → (∀ b ∈ s, (f ⁻¹' {b}).Finite) → (f ⁻¹' s).Finite
items.informal_description: If $ s $ is a finite set and for every element $ b \in s $, the preimage $ f^{-1}(\{b\}) $ is finite, then the preimage $ f^{-1}(s) $ is finite.

items.informal_name: Dependent Image of Finite Set is Finite
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {s : Set α},
  s.Finite → ∀ (F : (i : α) → i ∈ s → β), {y | ∃ x, ∃ (hx : x ∈ s), F x hx = y}.Finite
items.informal_description: If $ s $ is a finite set and $ F $ is a dependent function from $ s $ to $ \beta $, then the image of $ F $, defined as $ \{ y \in \beta \mid \exists x \in s,\ F(x) = y \} $, is a finite set in $ \beta $.

items.informal_name: Finite Set from Finite Preimage and Subset of Image
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {f : α → β} {s : Set β}, (f ⁻¹' s).Finite → s ⊆ Set.range f → s.Finite
items.informal_description: If the preimage $ f^{-1}(s) $ of a set $ s $ under a function $ f $ is finite and $ s $ is a subset of the image of $ f $, then $ s $ is finite.

items.informal_name: Image of a Finite Set Under a Function is Finite
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (s : Set α) (f : α → β) [Finite ↑s], Finite ↑(f '' s)
items.informal_description: The image of a finite set under any function is finite.

items.informal_name: Finite Range of Function with Finite Domain
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u} {ι : Sort w} (f : ι → α) [Finite ι], Finite ↑(Set.range f)
items.informal_description: If $ \iota $ is a finite type and $ f : \iota \to \alpha $ is a function, then the range (image) of $ f $ is a finite subset of $ \alpha $. This instance asserts that the image of a finite set under any function remains finite.

items.informal_name: Image of Finite Sets Under Function Application is Finite
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (f : Set (α → β)) (s : Set α) [Finite ↑f] [Finite ↑s], Finite ↑(f.seq s)
items.informal_description: If $ f $ is a finite set of functions from $ \alpha $ to $ \beta $ and $ s $ is a finite subset of $ \alpha $, then the set $ \{ f(a) \mid f \in f,\, a \in s \} $ obtained by applying all functions in $ f $ to all elements in $ s $ is finite.
